dogecoin.text: I bought more Dogecoin which isn’t something I expected to write last week

My fellow dogecoin holders, it’s time for some of you to get realistic. 

No, it’s not the next Bitcoin or even a moderately successful coin that’s going to be worth $100. 

It has a market cap of $46 billion already and a growing supply of 129.6 billion. It’s trading at .39.
